label: Team Scan Sharing Actually Saves The Team
desc: Scans could be assigned to a team in theory, but nothing that started a scan ever recorded which team it belonged to, so a team's shared scan view was always empty no matter how many scans members ran. Every way of starting a scan (single URL, crawl, bulk, authenticated, GitHub repo) now accepts a team and stores it, and the team is checked against the teams you are actually allowed to publish into. Scans stay personal unless you pick a team.

label: Feature Switches Now Reach The Whole Feature
desc: Turning a feature off in the admin panel only ever blocked part of it. PDF reports stayed downloadable by direct link after being switched off, and webhook deliveries kept firing to registered endpoints. Both now honour the switch, and all nine feature switches are readable by the app itself so disabled features can be hidden instead of failing at the last step.

label: Faster Start For Every Scan
desc: Starting a scan used to wait on a chain of separate database and DNS lookups one after another, and it counted your running scans twice. The independent checks now run at the same time and the duplicate count is gone, so the scan is acknowledged noticeably sooner. Nothing about which scans are allowed has changed.
